name: navbar
title: Navbar
description: Site header with a brand, menu links, an actions area, and a mobile menu opened by a toggle button.

props.name: links
props.description: Main menu. Links with active get aria-current=page.

props.name: brand
props.description: Logo or site name on the left.

props.name: actions
props.description: Right-hand area, such as a Sign in button.

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the mobile menu button.

props.name: navLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the desktop nav element.

props.name: mobileNavLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the mobile nav element.

a11y: The mobile menu button uses aria-expanded and aria-controls pointing to the menu panel.
Escape closes the panel and returns focus to the menu button.
The desktop and mobile menus are each wrapped in a nav with different labels (navLabel and mobileNavLabel).
The layout follows the header width (container query), the desktop menu shows from 42rem wide.

ai.whenToUse: Main header at the top of every page of a site or app.
rules: Mark the current page with active
Keep the number of main links small, move the rest to the footer or a dropdown

id.description: Header situs dengan brand, menu link, area aksi, dan menu seluler yang bisa dibuka lewat tombol.

props.links: Menu utama. Link dengan active diberi aria-current=page.
props.brand: Logo atau nama situs di kiri.
props.menuLabel: Label aksesibel tombol menu seluler. Default "Menu" sudah cocok untuk Bahasa Indonesia.
props.navLabel: Label aksesibel nav desktop. Isi "Utama" untuk situs berbahasa Indonesia.
props.mobileNavLabel: Label aksesibel nav seluler. Isi "Utama seluler" untuk situs berbahasa Indonesia.

a11y: Tombol menu seluler memakai aria-expanded dan aria-controls yang menunjuk ke panel menu.
Escape menutup panel dan fokus kembali ke tombol menu.
Menu desktop dan seluler masing-masing dibungkus nav dengan label berbeda (navLabel dan mobileNavLabel).
Tata letak mengikuti lebar header (container query), menu desktop tampil mulai lebar 42rem.

ai.whenToUse: Header utama di bagian atas setiap halaman situs atau aplikasi.
rules: Tandai halaman saat ini dengan active
Jaga jumlah link utama sedikit, sisanya taruh di footer atau dropdown
